import math, itertools, random, heapq, bisect, ast
from collections import Counter, deque
from functools import lru_cache

def smallest_range(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    rows = [list(map(int, row.split())) for row in lines[1:]]
    heap = [(row[0], i, 0) for (i, row) in enumerate(rows)]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    high = max((row[0] for row in rows))
    best = (high - heap[0][0], heap[0][0], high)
    while True:
        (low, i, j) = heapq.heappop(heap)
        best = min(best, (high - low, low, high))
        j += 1
        if j == len(rows[i]):
            break
        value = rows[i][j]
        high = max(high, value)
        heapq.heappush(heap, (value, i, j))
    return f'{best[1]} {best[2]}'
import sys
sys.stdout.write(smallest_range(sys.stdin.read()) + '\n')

import math, itertools, random, heapq, bisect, ast
from collections import Counter, deque
from functools import lru_cache

def infinite_set(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    smallest = 1
    heap = []
    added = set()
    out = []
    for line in lines[1:]:
        row = line.split()
        if row[0] == 'popSmallest':
            if heap:
                v = heapq.heappop(heap)
                added.remove(v)
            else:
                v = smallest
                smallest += 1
            out.append(str(v))
        else:
            v = int(row[1])
            if v < smallest and v not in added:
                heapq.heappush(heap, v)
                added.add(v)
    return '\n'.join(out)
import sys
sys.stdout.write(infinite_set(sys.stdin.read()) + '\n')

import math, heapq, bisect, itertools, random
from collections import deque, Counter
from functools import lru_cache
from decimal import Decimal

def deviation(text):
    a = [int(v) for v in text.split()]
    a = [v * 2 if v % 2 else v for v in a]
    low = min(a)
    heap = [-v for v in a]
    heapq.heapify(heap)
    best = -heap[0] - low
    while heap[0] % 2 == 0:
        v = -heapq.heappop(heap) // 2
        low = min(low, v)
        heapq.heappush(heap, -v)
        best = min(best, -heap[0] - low)
    return str(best)
import sys
sys.stdout.write(deviation(sys.stdin.read()) + '\n')
